contractStatus: P60-A discovery verified for applicable CI; P60-B source blueprint and coverage audit implemented on Satyam; P60-C–F planned

product.name: Practice Desk
product.purpose: Offline examination authoring, practice, scoring, history, analytics and spaced revision
product.runtime: Standalone offline HTML with local device storage; external Node 24 authoring CLI

recommendedSequence: Run read-only capability list or show one named capability
Read one relevant authoring example/task contract
Translate user coverage and source constraints to a v1 content blueprint and validate it before creating question batches
Audit all planned source batches against the exact blueprint; do not treat authored classification as factual truth
Run canonical QA/compile and targeted corrections

existingAgentOperations.effect: Bounded metadata/QA issues; no entire question set
One source question + shared context; image bytes omitted
SHA-guarded edits; no original overwrite; material edits reopen review
Full deterministic/heuristic QA report, not fact checking
Canonical validated publication package; explicit offline browser import remains necessary
Check versioned plan, exact integer quotas, parent contradictions, source and paper-rule policy syntax; no content generation
Bounded cross-batch count/metadata/QA audit; not factual truth; no keys or media bytes in output
Single-bank canonical compiler refuses publication output when explicit content quotas fail

trustBoundaries: A claim, link, SHA hash, second-model agreement or structurally valid package does not authenticate answers/PYQs/sources
Preserve candidate-facing content separately from answers, rubrics and editorial notes until authorized result review
User-local history and learning data are not accessible to the external agent by default
Do not promise direct app UI or database mutation from the Node source CLI
P60-B offers explicit source metadata quotas; it does not authenticate source factual correctness, learner cognition or actual curriculum coverage. P60-C through P60-F remain planned.

capabilities.summary: Separate built-in SSC CGL sources from imported exam families and paper/revision/edition selections.
provides: Browse available families and paper editions
Distinguish source/reviewed/custom and source identities
Effective exam rules derive from selected frozen paper
capabilities.agentUse: Choose examId/paperId explicitly; never infer official status from a name or user-imported bank.
limitations: Imported content is not automatically certified official
New exam bank content is not shipped merely because the engine supports its exam

capabilities.summary: One generic six-kind question engine with frozen answer key, marking rules and bounded partial/manual evaluation.
provides: single-choice
multiple-select
numeric-entry
true-false
matching
free-response
Correct/incorrect/blank/excluded/pending outcomes
Optional component partial-credit for matching and multiple-select
Exact frozen marks and source snapshots
capabilities.agentUse: Author in the existing external v1 format; validate using canonical compiler and score oracle, never create independent marks in the bank tool.
limitations: Free response needs separate manual grading; do not label it auto-scored
A valid published key is not proof that the answer is factually correct

capabilities.summary: Untimed, whole-paper and section-timed examination policies, navigation/review restrictions and an offline-safe route controller.
provides: Authored timed/untimed sections and pause rules
Sequential-locked or free movement per validated policies
Question flags and review behavior according to the paper
Offline Navigation API with file/fragment fallback
capabilities.agentUse: Declare timing and navigation in the authored paper; avoid inferring CAT/APFC rules from examId.
limitations: No universal arbitrary custom timer or live cloud scheduling interface
Linux WebKit browser tests are not physical Mac Safari certification

capabilities.summary: Semantic academic Subject → Topic → Subtopic independent of physical exam sections, with nine APFC broad syllabus headings.
provides: Author-supplied subject/topic/subtopic
APFC official broad syllabus root IDs
Topic ancestor rollups and unclassified handling
Exam-specific filters and learning attribution
capabilities.agentUse: Distinguish one physical APFC exam section from multiple academic syllabus headings; never invent subtopic authority.
limitations: Detailed verified syllabi, topic quotas and automatically calibrated difficulty are not supplied
User metadata is not automatically official

capabilities.summary: Deterministic selection from one validated frozen source paper, with available section/topic/difficulty filters.
provides: Seeded reproducible question selection
Real inventory and insufficient-stock error
Source and answer-key integrity maintained
capabilities.agentUse: Inspect actual source inventory before promising user question counts or distribution.
limitations: Composition operates on one source paper at a time; not arbitrary cross-exam combining
P60-B source-level coverage audits are available, but the local browser's practice composer is still single-paper and does not enforce blueprints automatically

capabilities.summary: Saved graded attempts, per-item outcomes, time/evidence analytics, results views and source-immutable history.
provides: Marks, correct/incorrect/blank/excluded or pending verdicts
Measured response time and visit evidence where recorded
Source/mode-aware history filters and protected snapshots
capabilities.agentUse: Use only reported measurements, never estimate unseen time, rank, percentile or cross-paper normalization.
limitations: There is no remote agent API to user device History
History data is device-local and must be explicitly exported/authorized before use

capabilities.summary: Learning cards, notebook classifications, FSRS-based explicit review scheduling and evidence-backed revision selections.
provides: User-authored notes, error labels, bookmarks and topic assignments
Wrong, blank, slow, repeated, flagged, bookmarked and due revision reasons
Frozen source and answer lineage; user review grades separated from exam marks
capabilities.agentUse: Suggest revision from evidence and learner authorization, not a medical/cognitive diagnosis or automatic regrade.
limitations: Revision reasons do not prove why a learner got an answer wrong
No built-in external AI agent access to private learning cards

capabilities.summary: Built-in SSC CGL original/reviewed source, caution/invalid flags, source-key comparison and immutable editorial records.
provides: Source vs reviewed comparison where semantic correspondence is valid
Preserved SSC CGL answer-key correction decisions and caution labels
Editorial/provenance fields in question revisions
capabilities.agentUse: Preserve original and corrected identities; use caution for unattributed imported claims.
limitations: Universal P60-D original/reviewed lineage for any imported/PYQ/AI bank does not yet exist
An attributed official PYQ URL is not independently authenticated

capabilities.summary: P57–P59 external AI source format, strict deterministic compiler and QA, compact inspect/show/patch and offline Wordgard staging/publishing.
provides: practice-desk-authoring v1 source, versioned source IDs
Headless inspect (paged issues) and show (single item, no image bytes)
Guarded create-new patch/add/update/unset/remove
Cross-bank duplicate candidates and source-metadata warnings
Wordgard manual correction, lossless distinct draft exchange, immutable caution publication
capabilities.agentUse: Read docs/AGENT_AUTHORING_QUICKSTART.md plus one example; research externally; compile and import via Library.
limitations: No embedded LLM, automatic cloud/device sync or direct browser agent bridge
Structural/scorer QA does not authenticate factual truth, official PYQs, reviewer or legal commencement
Staging accepts at most 8 source files/400 staged questions; max 200 selected in Wordgard

capabilities.summary: Shared case/passage/table/chart/image stimuli, image references, canonical rich text and KaTeX mathematical display.
provides: Shared stimuli cited once by question ID
Rich question content with linear math alternatives
Embedded validated image inventory and zoom/pan display
Conservative optional image preparation workflow
capabilities.agentUse: Use one shared stimulus for CAT DILR/RC; use image asset IDs and alt text without placing base64 data into agent inspection results.
limitations: PDF/image extraction is external AI work; not an offline app PDF ingestion feature
Actual tactile/assistive math or image quality on physical hardware requires user verification

capabilities.summary: Local offline single HTML, immutable SHA-covered exam/source history, shared snapshot backup v4 and separate unpublished staging/draft archives.
provides: Strict checked exam package imports
Snapshot-deduplicated saved attempt backup and recovery
Separate export/import of unpublished author drafts and staging
Cross-tab stale-change protections within documented limits
capabilities.agentUse: Do not touch local storage directly; instruct explicit export/import and preserve independent backups of unpublished work.
limitations: History v4 backup does not include unpublished draft/staging archives
No cross-device sync or restoration after all local data and backups are lost
Browser-origin/physical OS storage loss not guaranteed

capabilities.summary: P60-B versioned content production blueprint, bounded multi-batch quota audit and optional exact canonical compiler preflight.
provides: Validate user-authored exam, paper, subject and topic targets before content generation
Enforce exhaustive or partial exact counts across subject, topic, subtopic, difficulty, kind, origin and physical section
Optional explicit user marking, timer and navigation constraints
Unverified author-attributed cognitive-level sidecar and counts
Detect source ID duplicates, repeated stems, missing explanations/citations, excluded topics and topic overconcentration
Compact requested-versus-actual coverage and observed category inventories without question text
Optional --blueprint guard for exact single-source canonical validate or compile
capabilities.agentUse: Start from docs/architecture/P60B_CONTENT_BLUEPRINT.md plus one exam blueprint example; validate the user-defined plan, generate batches, audit entire intended composition before importing; use --blueprint on one-file compilation.
limitations: No automatic syllabus truth, cognitive calibration, fact verification or source authentication
The current offline browser can import without a blueprint; CLI enforcement requires an explicit --blueprint flag or content-blueprint audit
Multi-file aggregate audit is not a new 400-item in-app staging interface or cross-paper engine
Author cognitive labels require a separate explicit sidecar and are not independently assessed

plannedProgramme.name: Independent semantic, source-grounded and answer-leakage QA
External AI PDF extraction and ingestion
Permission-scoped agent interaction and measured end-to-end QA
